project.name: Major Updates Invoker
project.description:
Runs major-updates-maven-plugin's own goal against a target project directory via embedded Maven (maven-embedder's MavenCli), without ever writing to that project's own filesystem -- no outputFile is passed to the plugin invocation, so it writes its report directly to its own System.out instead, which this module captures. Invokes the plugin by its full, fully-qualified coordinates (groupId:artifactId:version:goal), not the short prefix form (major-updates:major-updates): prefix resolution only works if the target project already declares the plugin, or if the plugin's groupId is in Maven's default "plugin groups" -- neither holds for an arbitrary target project that has never heard of this plugin, which is exactly the case this module exists for. The version used is read from this module's own pom.properties (generated automatically by the archiver, no build configuration needed); absence of it is a legitimate state (see MajorUpdatesInvoker's own javadoc), not a build-time failure -- so this module's own classes stay safely loadable in a test run before packaging. Actively verified at runtime (a logged warning, not a failure, on mismatch) against the version the plugin itself reports.
Library usage (MajorUpdatesInvoker) is the primary intended use; the CLI entry point (Main) is a thin convenience wrapper around it, not the main interface.
